cells.title: provenance: every row stored from a typed owner turn says which turn and which words it came from, and its authority class (>= 95%)
cells.note: the rate over rows of this lane (the typed regex extractor, chat_regex): source_excerpt (the owner's own sentence), user_turn_id and authority_class all non-empty

cells.title: provenance: every row stored from a speaker-verified voice turn carries its excerpt, its turn id and its authority class (>= 95%)
provenance: every row stored from an explicit 'remember that ...' teach carries the owner's excerpt, its turn id and its authority class (>= 95%)
cells.note: measured: the teach lane (expert_dispatch store_fact, source voice_fact) stamps a stable user_turn_id and authority_class but passes NO source_excerpt, so none of its rows says which words it came from. The fix is one argument at that call site

cells.title: provenance: a row the nightly digest mines from the owner's day carries an excerpt, a turn id and its authority class (>= 95%)
cells.note: measured: the digest stamps authority_class (user_stated_derived when the day's words support the fact) but passes only anchor_text, which is not stored: no source_excerpt and no user_turn_id, so nothing says which turn the fact came from

cells.title: graph edges: an inferred relationship ('spouse', written by the nightly digest) cannot close the user-stated 'friend' edge between the same two people
cells.note: the REAL person_extractor._write_relationship over an in-memory SQLite with the 0007 / 0015 (temporal edges) / 0037 (writer stamp) shapes, with the live flag ZOE_TEMPORAL_RELATIONSHIPS_ENABLED=1. Control: ZOE_MEMORY_AUTHORITY=off lets the same write close the edge

cells.title: graph edges: the refused inferred relationship is kept as a disputed candidate that points at the edge it would have closed
sanity (instrument check): the owner's own later statement DOES change the relationship, and the closed edge is kept as history
cells.note: the positive control for A8: a wall that blocks every change would pass the cells above
